source: research/screenshots/prompt_page_15.png and prompt_page_16.png; RPT-001, RPT-002, RPT-003
inputs: Only integrity-checked saved report/result JSON. No raw prices, detector feature records, credentials or sealed datasets are read or embedded. Combined decks preserve each source's identity and never imply comparable accounts or independent markets.
provenance: Every displayed research value, date, numeric label and chart coordinate has a saved source name/hash, typed JSON path, row/column, raw value, format and shown text. A separate Decimal-based reader independently resolves and formats every fact before HTML is returned; missing/mismatched/unreferenced facts reject the entire build. Page ordinals, stage dimensions and navigation controls are presentation structure, not research measures.
coverage: Account daily equity/profit, costs and concentration; passive cash/buy-hold; matched-account comparison; every behavior table row in bounded groups; every paired-ablation row; search/final summary rows. Unsupported or oversized saved output fails explicitly instead of omitting findings. Full saved report remains a separate JSON export.
display: Navy #0b0f1a, cyan/amber, white noun titles, single-line description, one chart per finding and at most two large stats. A 1920x1080 stage scales to fit; bottom-right 520x368 remains empty except optional camera-area guide. No webcam access. Gains/losses have signs and text as well as color. Undefined/inconclusive and negative absolute profit remain explicit; no invented survived verdict.
controls: Arrow keys, Space and PageUp/PageDown navigate; Home/End jump; hash #N opens page N; M opens section menu; R replays build; F toggles camera guide; pointer ring follows mouse; drag draws yellow marks fading after a few seconds. Visible focus, keyboard menu and reduced-motion support.
security: Single HTML, inline data/styles/runtime/SVG, no external assets or network, no eval or dynamic HTML insertion, strict CSP. Escape untrusted source text and reject invalid/nonfinite/duplicate-key JSON, credential-like fields on selected output surfaces and unsafe source names. Original report bytes unchanged.
limits: At most 16 saved sources, 2048 pages, 100000 facts, 10000 points per series and 32 MiB source/HTML budgets. These are explicit implementation guards, not measured operating-envelope claims. A source outside limits is rejected without a partial export.
verification: Retain authored first failures; verify independent provenance and tampering rejection, original preservation, all report adapters and every included row, actual guarded saved-report API, sealed/raw-read exclusion and real offline browser controls/layout/screenshots/page manifest at 1920x1080 and1280x720. These component receipts cannot certify all397 acceptance cases.
